items.title: 'Let down by the system': Colleagues and patients complained for years about surgeon
items.description: Complaints had been made about this gynaecologist for years. Only when hospital management discovered that Four Corners was looking into his practice, did it start investigating further.

items.title: Live: Police scour bushland for kidnapped Sydney man Chris Baghsarian
items.description: Police officers are scouring dense bushland in Sydney's north-west for the missing 85-year-old grandfather, following a police operation overnight.

items.title: Albanese changes his tune on immigration as One Nation effect hits
items.description: A lot has been written about One Nation cannibalising the Coalition's vote, but less attention has been given to how the rise of the once-fringe party is also activating Labor.

items.title: Charles Darwin University vice-chancellor resigns amid accreditation scandal
items.description: Charles Darwin University's vice-chancellor Scott Bowman has resigned following an accreditation scandal that has impacted almost 300 of the university's TAFE students.

items.title: Michael Rowland to leave ABC after four decades
items.description: After almost four decades in front of the camera, former News Breakfast host Michael Rowland announces he is leaving the ABC.

items.title: Andrew's daughters to be shielded by King Charles
items.description: Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor's arrest has cast another long shadow over the York family. While his ex-wife, Sarah Ferguson, has vanished from public view, their daughters Beatrice and Eugenie face an uncertain future.

items.title: Two big tax holes are perpetuating Australia's wealth inequality
items.description: Intergenerational inequality will only be dealt with by taxing the people that have the money, not by cutting the taxes of those who don't have it.

items.title: Brisbane owner quoted $70,000 a year as home insurance premiums surge
items.description: Home insurance premiums continue to rise, with properties in natural disaster-prone areas paying the most.

items.title: Iranian diaspora says they face threats and intimidation in Australia
items.description: The Iranian diaspora in Australia says they are fearful for the safety of their loved ones abroad when speaking out.

items.title: US and Iran to meet for nuclear talks as fears of military conflict rise
items.description: The third round of talks between the US and Iran comes amid growing tensions between the long-time adversaries.

items.title: Live: PM casts Farrer by-election as a test for Taylor on One Nation preferences
items.description: Anthony Albanese says the upcoming by-election will be a test for both Angus Taylor and David Littleproud in how they handle One Nation. Follow live.

items.title: For the Olympics to remain relevant, it is essential it embraces sustainability
items.description: Olympic Games chief executive Christophe Dubi tells ABC Sport that in order for the Olympics to remain relevant, it simply has to embrace sustainable practices.

items.title: Mexican army kills drug boss 'El Mencho' as country ramps up pressure on cartels
items.description: Powerful Mexican drug lord Nemesio Rubén Cervantes, known as "El Mencho", is killed in a military raid, sparking a wave of unrest and violence in several Mexican states.

items.title: Coalition calls to criminalise help to ISIS-linked Australians seeking return
items.description: The federal opposition proposes a new criminal offence to punish those who help Australians with links to Islamic State to return home, accusing the government of being complacent about the possible return of 34 wives and children of former fighters.

items.title: BAFTAs Film Awards see best actor upset, Aussies miss out
items.description: British actor Robert Aramayo has beaten frontrunners Timothée Chalamet and Leonardo DiCaprio to take the leading actor BAFTA.

items.title: The five-minute technique that can help reduce your stress
items.description: Experts say we don't need to overhaul our lives to reduce our stress effectively. Here are some tips you can use right now.

items.title: Inner-city art project revives the disposable camera
items.description: A unique community exhibition in Perth is celebrating the "messiness and spontaneity" of the disposable camera.

items.title: Crypto and Starlink used to roll out first universal basic income plan
items.description: Citizens of the Marshall Islands will receive "free money" as the government launches a world-first universal basic income scheme.

items.title: Live: Wall Street gains after new global tariff decision, ASX slides as gold jumps
items.description: While Wall Street has closed higher following the US threatening a new higher global tariff, the ASX has dropped. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog.

items.title: 'Top priority' database to help catch child abusers years away from working
items.description: A key government commitment to protect children from sexual predators will not be "fully functional" for at least three years.

items.title: The 'amazing' experience of landing a jet on an ice runway
items.description: The ice runway at Wilkins Aerodrome is a critical asset in the Australian Antarctic Program, but getting it ready for flights is nothing short of extreme.

items.title: Man carrying shotgun killed while entering Trump's Mar-a-Lago
items.description: United States Secret Service agents shoot dead a man carrying a shotgun and a fuel can after he breaches the secure perimeter at Mar-a-Lago.

items.title: No proof necessary to receive power bill help in rules shake-up
items.description: Amid soaring prices and rising levels of energy hardship, the regulator wants to strengthen the protections for vulnerable customers.

items.title: As the last station opens, a question remains: Was WA's Metronet worth the cost?
items.description: The completion of the new Midland train station brings an end to Labor's landmark Metronet project. At a cost of $15 billion, the project's final test now begins — whether West Australians believe it was money well spent.

items.title: Man under police guard after death at Geelong hospital
items.description: Officers find a man dead in a Geelong hospital room, with another man at the facility currently being kept under police guard.
